name: Sumiyoshi Chisato
source:
Chisato is a second year female student at the Takafuji Academy and Yuuki's childhood friend. She is the president of Shokken, and also Mifuyu's  best friend. [spoiler]She does not like chocolate due to the death of her younger brother, who was fond of chocolate.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Koi_to_Senkyo_to_Chocolate]Wikipedia[/url]]

She is [url=https://vndb.org/c12077]Ayumu's[/url] cousin.
